info.description: Returns engagement and spend statistics in this application for the currently authenticated user.
info.title: Google Play Game Services

requests.description: Lists all the achievement definitions for your application.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/achievements
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Updates multiple achievements for the currently authenticated player.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/achievements/updateMultiple
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Increments the steps of the achievement with the given ID for the currently authenticated player.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/achievements/{achievementId}/increment
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Sets the state of the achievement with the given ID to `REVEALED` for the currently authenticated player.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/achievements/{achievementId}/reveal
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Sets the steps for the currently authenticated player towards unlocking an achievement. If the steps parameter is less than the current number of steps that the player already gained for the achievement, the achievement is not modified.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/achievements/{achievementId}/setStepsAtLeast
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Unlocks this achievement for the currently authenticated player.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/achievements/{achievementId}/unlock
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a URL for the requested end point type.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/applications/getEndPoint
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Indicate that the currently authenticated user is playing your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/applications/played
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Retrieves the metadata of the application with the given ID. If the requested application is not available for the specified `platformType`, the returned response will not include any instance data.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/applications/{applicationId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Verifies the auth token provided with this request is for the application with the specified ID, and returns the ID of the player it was granted for.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/applications/{applicationId}/verify
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of the event definitions in this application.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/eventDefinitions
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Returns a list showing the current progress on events in this application for the currently authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/events
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Records a batch of changes to the number of times events have occurred for the currently authenticated user of this application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/events
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Lists all the leaderboard metadata for your application.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/leaderboards
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Submits multiple scores to leaderboards.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/leaderboards/scores
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Retrieves the metadata of the leaderboard with the given ID.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Submits a score to the specified leaderboard.
requests.name: POST /games/v1/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}/scores
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the scores in a leaderboard, starting from the top.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}/scores/{collection}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the scores in a leaderboard around (and including) a player's score.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}/window/{collection}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Return the metagame configuration data for the calling application.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/metagameConfig
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Get the application player ids for the currently authenticated player across all requested games by the same developer as the calling application. This will only return ids for players that actually have an id (scoped or otherwise) with that game.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/me/multipleApplicationPlayerIds
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Get the collection of players for the currently authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/me/players/{collection}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves scoped player identifiers for currently authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/me/scopedIds
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Retrieves the Player resource with the given ID. To retrieve the player for the currently authenticated user, set `playerId` to `me`.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/{playerId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists the progress for all your application's achievements for the currently authenticated player.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/{playerId}/achievements
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List play data aggregated per category for the player corresponding to `playerId`.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/{playerId}/categories/{collection}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get high scores, and optionally ranks, in leaderboards for the currently authenticated player. For a specific time span, `leaderboardId` can be set to `ALL` to retrieve data for all leaderboards in a given time span. `NOTE: You cannot ask for 'ALL' leaderboards and 'ALL' timeSpans in the same request; only one parameter may be set to 'ALL'.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/{playerId}/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}/scores/{timeSpan}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of snapshots created by your application for the player corresponding to the player ID.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/players/{playerId}/snapshots
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Checks whether the games client is out of date.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/revisions/check
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Retrieves the metadata for a given snapshot ID.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/snapshots/{snapshotId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns engagement and spend statistics in this application for the currently authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /games/v1/stats
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_SERVICES_API_KEY}} with your API key
